title: Fix build failure when frontend_path is set without prerendering
author: masenf
awaiting: no reviewer requested; self-authored by masenf, blocked by missing human (non-author) review and by an unresolved greptile Windows-traversal finding on the new head

unresolved.first_comment: Windows Path Escapes Output: On Windows, a frontend_path such as '..\\escaped' passes the slash-only parent-segment validation. Joining that value to the Windows static_dir treats the backslash as a separator and resolves '..', so the build creates a directory outside .web/build/client and moves all static output there. Reject Windows-style parent segments or verify that the resolved prefix remains inside static_dir.

failing_job_findings.cause: Infra/network flake, not a code problem: the job's setup step (astral-sh/setup-uv) failed with '##[error]fetch failed' while fetching https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astral-sh/versions/main/v1/uv.ndjson to resolve the uv version to install, before any repository code ran. All later steps (Setup Node, Install Dependencies) were skipped as a result. This is unrelated to the PR's diff.

outstanding_asks.ask: New finding posted today at 22:51:43Z on the current head (364143939): the '..' rejection added in 04b3cefe only checks for POSIX-style parent segments (split on '/'), but on Windows a frontend_path like '..\\escaped' still passes validation and, once joined to static_dir, escapes the intended .web/build/client output directory (same root cause as the P1 fixed this morning, now shown to be incompletely fixed cross-platform).
